verdict.rationale: AgentMail is a hosted email API, and its docs describe only the managed service. The only evidence of self-hosted or customer-controlled deployment is a community comment that the enterprise options include Bring Your Own Cloud, which would put the mail pipeline in the customer's own environment. Custom domains and open-source SDKs are adjacent features and do not count as self-hosting. missing for 10: first-party documentation of self-hosting or Bring Your Own Cloud deployment, details on what pipeline components run under customer control, availability outside enterprise plans, hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a switcher, I can self-host the email app and keep the mail pipeline under my own control

citations.quote: They appreciated that the enterprise options include Bring Your Own Cloud
appreciated the Bring Your Own Cloud enterprise option, saying it makes things much easier
